A1-278r2-1: scripts/commit-when-clean.mjs reads the index file (git rev-parse --git-path index) byte for byte before it runs anything, samples the tree with git --no-optional-locks status, and on every refusal of its own (a failed git add -A, a verifier not clean, 90, 92, 95) writes those bytes back through index.lock and a rename, instead of git read-tree <tree>; per-entry flags (intent-to-add, assume-unchanged, skip-worktree, sparse and other extended bits) come back with the tree and the staged set. The verifier runs asynchronously in its own process group; SIGINT, SIGTERM or SIGHUP between staging and the commit stops it, puts the index back and exits 128 + the signal number (new codes 129, 130, 143), which also answers A1-278-2 (Info).

A1-278r2-2: CHILD_ENV in test-kits/ratchets-bite.test.mjs removes every GIT_* variable as a class (beside NODE_TEST_CONTEXT and NODE_OPTIONS) and is now the environment of every child the file starts: runSuite's suites, isolateGit's and throwawayRepository's git, the commit gate, the sweep case's node.

Three cases added, none removed or renamed: 'the commit gate's refusals put the index file back byte for byte, its per-entry flags included', 'the commit gate puts the index back and stops its verifier when it is interrupted', 'a caller's GIT_* environment reaches no repository but the cases' own'. Measured to fail on the old code: the first two with origin/main's scripts/commit-when-clean.mjs (flags dropped; the gate dies of SIGTERM), the third with the GIT_* line removed from CHILD_ENV (with GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE set the cases fail on the other repository; with only GIT_INDEX_FILE and GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY set the cases fail too).

security_privacy_cost_impact: Local commit tooling and its tests. The commit gate now writes the caller's own index bytes back on a refusal instead of a tree-derived index, so a skip-worktree or assume-unchanged local edit (a common way to keep a private configuration out of commits) stays hidden after a refusal; the test children can no longer act on a repository named by an inherited GIT_* variable. No credential, personal data, customer data, provider call, CI file, RFC or contract.
compatibility_impact: No contract changes. scripts/commit-when-clean.mjs keeps its usage and every exit code, and adds 129, 130 and 143 for SIGHUP, SIGINT and SIGTERM between staging and the commit (previously the gate died of the signal). The verifier runs in a process group of its own, so a terminal's Ctrl-C reaches it through the gate.
known_limitations: SIGKILL, or a crash of the gate itself, still leaves the index staged; a failing git commit leaves it staged, as on main (R0-278-1, C0-278-3).

The gate itself still honours its own caller's GIT_* (run from a hook it stages into the hook's index, as git does); A1's 'the gate's ... child environment' (A1-AUD1017-1 (2)) is read as the gate the cases start, whose environment has no GIT_*.

The GIT_* case runs the commit-gate cases but the .config/ one in its child (that one's git calls are isolateGit and the gate, as the red-tree case's are); runSuite's suites get CHILD_ENV by construction and are not run under a redirected GIT_* by any case.
A1-278-3 (Info: a write between the first sample and git add -A that is reverted before the second sample is committed unverified) is unchanged.
